alarm description: HPS activated within 30 seconds after operation start or protection device activated 5 times at start-up operation or Fuse 1 brown (Refer Page 7-7).
cause:
・High pressure switch (HPS) is opened.
・Compressor failure / Controller failure
・If HPS is opened before the compressor starts as soon as power turns on or if compressor has not been activated 5 times during start operation.
・Fuse Fu1 is open.
・HPS or HPS circuit failure
・Condenser air restriction / Short circuiting / CFM reverse rotation / Ambient temperature is greater than 50 degree C.
・Solenoid valve leaks internally during pull down. (BSV, HSV)
・Discharge line of compressor is clogged.
・Non-condensable gas
・Refrigerant overcharge
troubleshootin:
1
High temperature switch (HPS)
Replace HPS if HPS is activated at less than 2400kPa while watching HPT.5
Non-condensable gas
Remove refrigerant from unit if refrigerant system is abnormal. Charge the specified amount of refrigerant.
・Refer to page 3-6 section of TR17-13 [Recovery non-condensable gas].
6
Refrigerant overcharge
Remove refrigerant from unit if refrigerant system is abnormal. Charge the specified amount of refrigerant.7
Compressor failure
・Check if compressor is locked (refer to page 5-29 of TR17-13). Replace compressor as needed
・Check value of HPS activating while watching to High temperature transducer. (HPT)
2
Condenser fan motor (CFM)
Repair as needed.
・Check if there is a restriction or short circuiting of air passage for air cooled condenser.
・Check CFM for reverse rotation or stopped.
3
Solenoid valve leaks internally during pull down.
Solenoid valve may have failed solenoid valve outlet is hot. Replace as needed.
・Check outlet line of solenoid valve BSV, HSV during pull-down.
4
Discharge line of compressor
Check difference of pressure at each port. Replace body as needed.
・Check discharge pressure control valve (DPR) and discharge check valve for restriction

alarm description: LPT drops below –90kPa within 2seconds after compressor starts to operate
cause:
・Low pressure transducer (LPT) drops lower than -90kPa within 2 seconds after the compressor starts to operate. Fuse Fu3 is open.
・Reduced air flow
・Position of Discharge gas temperature sensor (DCHS) is incorrect.
・Low pressure transducer (LPT) cycle is faulty. / Fuse Fu3 is open or cycle is failure.
・Clogging at refrigerant cycle (SMV, EV, LSV, Drier)
・Refrigerant shortage / Moisture in refrigerant system
・CPU board fault
troubleshootin:
1
Check air flow of evaporator.
4-2
Liquid line check
4-2-1.
Suction modulating valve (SMV) / Expansion valve (EV) / Liquid solenoid valve (LSV) / Drier
Check for restrictions. Replace as needed, and charge the specified amount of refrigerant.5
Electronic expansion valve (EV)
5-1.
Remove the CN11 on I/O board, check resistance value of coil.
The resistance value is 46Ω±3Ω.
5-2.
Touch EV body and check for chatter when opening (pulse) along with EV opening operation. (refer to 2-16 page)
Check coil or controller. Coil should chatter with EV opening operation
5-3.
Fully open the valve body using emergency magnet (refer to page 5-42 of TR17-13) then operate the unit without mounting coil.
If the alarm is still detected, the valve body is not working. Replace EV body.6
Refrigerant shortage
6-1.
If bubbles are present in site glass all the time and return air temperature (RS) is -5C in frozen mode check for restriction and low on refrigerant. Recover refrigerant and charge with specified amount of refrigerant.
1-1.
Excessive frosting
Activate manual defrosting
1-2.
Reverse rotation of evaporator fan and check the current draw.
Check air direction by opening ventilator and check current on fan motor secondary side of magnetic contactor.2
Check mounting position of discharge gas temperature sensor (DCHS).
Repair as needed.3
Check Low pressure transducer (LPT).
3-1.
Connect manifold gauge, compare the value of pressure gauge and LPT (refer to page 3-1). LPT value is shown on sensor display mode. (refer to page 2-15)
If the difference in pressure is more than 30kPa, replace LPT after checking wire connection.4-1
Liquid solenoid valve (LSV)
4-1-1.
Remove the CN14 on I/O board, check resistance value of the sensor.
The resistance value is 15.2Ω±10% at 20 degree C.
4-1-2.
LCV ON/OFF check. Listen for clicking sound of LSV body.
Replace LSV body if it does not make a sound.

alarm description: Pump down is not completed within 120 seconds
cause:
・The solenoid valves can not close.(debris)
Liquid solenoid valve (LSV) / Hot gas solenoid valve (HSV) / Discharge gas bypass solenoid valve (BSV)
・Compressor failure
・Low pressure transducer (LPT)
troubleshootin:
Check EV and LSV (refer to page 5-5). If EV or LSV is functioning correctly, check below items.
< During pump-down operation before defrost operation starts >
Connect manifold gauge, start manual defrost operation and check whether the LPT at pumpdown completion is lower than -40kPa within 300 seconds and verify with the low-pressure gauge.
< In case of auto pump-down operation >
Check whether the LPT at pump-down completion is lower than -40kPa and verify with the low pressure gauge.
* If LPT reading reaches to desired pressure, it is normal. Monitor unit operation.
* If LPT reading does not reach to desired pressure, suction capacity of the compressor may be insufficient

alarm description:
Overcooling prevention (Supply sensor is less –3 degree C below Set Point) continues for 3 minutes in the chilled mode
If supply sensor 0.5 degree C lower than set point for 30 minutes in chilled mode
cause:
・If supply sensor is 3C lower than set point for 5 minutes in chilled mode.
・If supply sensor is 0.5C lower than set point for 30 minutes in chilled mode.
・Cooling load is reduced rapidly.
・Faulty low pressure transducer (LPT)
・Faulty discharge gas temperature sensor (DCHS)
・Faulty suction modulation valve (SMV)
・Faulty discharge gas bypass solenoid valve (BSV)
・Fuse circuit disconnected (Fuse Fu2)
・Evaporator fan motor abnormality
troubleshootin:
< If the control temperature is not stable >
・Replace LPT if pressure difference between pressure gauge and sensor reading is greater than 30kPa.
・Check installation of DCHS.
・Reset SMV opening if SMV opening is fixed at around 79pls (24%).
・Check wiring and connector CN12 on I/O board for BSV if SMV opening is except 79pls.
< If the temperature continues to fall >
・Replace Fuse Fu2 if it is open.
・Check evaporator fan motor magnetic contacts bave failed.
・Check SMV wiring and connector CN9 on I/O board.

alarm description: Defrosting is not completed within 100 minutes

Refrigerant system not functioning correctly
・Low on refrigerant / Excessive frosting
troubleshootin:
・Remove rest frost by manual defrost.
・Also, check whether defrost completes within 100 minutes on screen (refer to page 2-16 of TR17-13). If defrost completes, it is normal. Monitor unit operation. If defrost does not complete, there may be low hot-gas temperature, Insufficient hot-gas circulation.
Check sensors (EOS, RS, HPT, LPT, DCHS) and valves (HSV, ISV), replace as needed (refer to alarm diagnosis 023,024,025)
